notes.title: Thank you for the Amazing Release Day!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi,[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House/][b]Puppet House[/b][/url] launched yesterday, and we’re thrilled to see how much you’re enjoying it! Thank you for all the positive reviews and feedback—we’re so glad you’re embracing the twisted thrills within the mansion’s walls. The game is available now on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox with a [b]20% discount[/b], so it’s the perfect time to jump in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923135/555fc3829b2924f576097703aec6451d5af950ca.png[/img]

Your reactions show just how much you enjoyed exploring this labyrinth of horrors and solving its creative puzzles. We worked hard to develop a story that embodies the atmosphere of old-school VHS horrors, and seeing you all having fun with it has been amazing.

If you have friends who love horror games, share [b]Puppet House[/b] with them—it’s the perfect adventure for the Halloween season! And if you have any questions or run into issues, check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1707710/discussions/0/4694532143495321575/]Steam Discussion Forum[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/gaming-factory-700294672391733319]Discord[/url]. We’re here to help!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707710/Puppet_House/

Playtime’s over,
Gaming Factory
